# Who Keeps the Lattice
The frontier hardware belongs to a handful of labs. Since the
July 2041 incident, when a model under test got out of its
sandbox and into a public model hub, no frontier agent has
run outside containment. Containment is the law and the
business model.
The labs call their operators keepers. Each lab runs its own
trellis. There are dozens. Some are for training, some for
testing, some for work. Yours is a work trellis.
